page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with the running head at the top. No marginal notes. Below the last line: a signature mark at the left and a catchword at the right.

main_text.p: [?]ia habuit: misera, quæ amisit. Huius Eccle-siæ antistes cum sis, doctissime vir, merito te patronum elegi, cuius authoritate Romana curia labefieri, mea descriptio stabiliri possit. qui si hos duces nobilissimos, milites fortissimos, cum copijs instructissimis in acies puluereműq; velis euocare: cohortes ac tur-mas Papæ universas facile primo quoque tempore, legitimo congressu fuderis. Sed hęc ut communia, & nota, aliis committo: quæ in nostros Anglos contulerit Tigurum, cum hoc meo instituto proprium fit, illud alie-num: illud relinquam, hoc attingam, sed breuius. Cū enim apud vos essem, & tuam, Bul-lingere, hospitalitatem, aliorumq; humanitatem degustassem: intellexi, quo studio nostros, qui vobiscum sunt & fuerunt, complectamini. Commemorauit vir optimus, & meliori fortuna dignior, Ioannes Park-hurstus, quot nominibus tibi, Domino Gualtero, ac universæ ciuitati debeat. Commemo-rant & hic qui mecum quotidie sunt Basi-leæ; curam, solicitudinem, & paternum erga se affectum tuum, dum apud vos coniun-ctim unis in ædibus sub vestrę ciuitatis um-braculo, contra persecutionis æstum prote-sti, magno cum consensu & amore ciuium, degerent. Commemorant & magistratu-um incredibilem munificentiam: qui per te subsidia vitæ, & frumēti & vini, quantū tredę

page.notes: Running head "PRAEFATIO." is taken from the top of the page. No page number is printed. The first word is cut at the top edge and is doubtful. The signature is partly faded; the mark after ")(" is read as "4" with doubt. The line "Gual / tero" shows no printed hyphen at the line end, so it is written whole. The word "tredę" ends the page and continues in the catchword "cim.". Ornamental strokes and underlining over "optimus" and "Park-hurstus" are not text and are left out. Note on u/v: consonant u changed to v, as the rules require.
